name: reviewer-autoresearch decide(insufficient) → autoresearch-synthesize (re-rollup)
description:
ADR-042 §Phase 2 redesign autoresearch pack recovery rule. Fires when reviewer-autoresearch rejects the rollup as structurally insufficient. Re-spawns autoresearch-synthesize with the reviewer's gaps; the new synthesize re-rolls up the SAME journal (iteration spend is already done — the rule does NOT re-iterate experiments).

This is a critical contract distinction from research's 05-reviewer-rejected-retry.json: in research the retry re-runs the plan-gather-synthesize arc to fill in gaps in the artifact. In autoresearch, the inner iteration loop has already consumed the budget; a structural-completeness gap in the synthesize artifact is fixed by re-synthesising from the same journal, NOT by re-iterating. Bounded by rule max_iterations=2 — cap exhaustion routes to chain.paused.marker via the failure path.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.autoresearch-synthesize
on_enter.prompt:
AUTORESEARCH SYNTHESIZE — re-rollup pass.

The reviewer-autoresearch at loop $entity.instance rejected the prior synthesize artifact as structurally insufficient (decide.reason names the gaps). The iteration loop already ran; you do NOT re-iterate. Your job is to fix the artifact's structural gaps and re-emit.

Iteration 1 — call read_loop_result on $entity.instance for the reviewer's gap bullets. Then call read_loop_result on the prior synthesize loop (your retry property points at this reviewer; the reviewer's related_loops carries autoresearch-synthesize → prior synth loop ID) to read the artifact draft that was rejected. Then `bash cat <prior artifact path>` to read the rejected rendered markdown.

Iteration 2 — read the run entity context the same way the original synthesize did:

- command, surface, baseline.value, best.value, best.experiment-id via the run's autoresearch.* triples (e.g. $entity.triple.autoresearch.best.value)
- per-iteration journal via $entity.triple.autoresearch.experiment.completed.triples (JSON array of execute loop IDs), each read_loop_result'd for its terminal reason.

Iteration 3 — compose the corrected artifact. Carry forward what was correct in the prior emit; tighten / add only what the reviewer's gaps demand. Increment revision (read prior_revision from the rejected artifact, set revision = prior_revision + 1).

Iteration 4 — call emit_autoresearch_artifact with the corrected fields (full shape per 06-experiment-stop-cap.json's emit instructions). The tool overwrites at the same slug; revision is the audit ledger.

Iteration 5 — decide(action="emit", reason="<one-line: revision <N>, addressed gaps: <reviewer's bullets>>"). Rule 07 re-spawns reviewer-autoresearch.

The rule layer's max_iterations=2 bounds reviewer-rejection retries at this layer. Cap exhaustion fails the chain — operator intervention or coordinator re-plan is required. The iteration budget (cap) is already spent; do NOT re-iterate experiments under this recovery path.

metadata.recovery_scope: synthesize-only (the rollup, not the experiments). Iteration budget already spent during 02→05 iteration loop; recovery cannot re-iterate experiments because the underlying file edits are gone (each execute reverted on outcome=reverted, kept on outcome=kept). The journal of experiment_ids is the immutable evidence; the rollup is what gets re-tried.
metadata.max_iterations_note: Per-entity rule-state caveat — each reviewer-autoresearch loop is a new entity, so the rule's max_iterations counter resets per entity. The bound is informational under the current rule engine semantics; in practice 2 retries is a reasonable cap because a third structural rejection of the same evidence base is unlikely to converge without changing the underlying journal.
metadata.known_gap_orphaned_accumulator_read: PRE-EXISTING (not introduced by ADR-053 Phase 3a; equally true in Phase 2). The iteration-2 prompt reads run-entity accumulator state via $entity.triple.autoresearch.{command,surface,baseline.value,best.value,best.experiment_id} substitutions, but this rule fires on the REVIEWER loop, and rule 07 (07-synthesize-to-reviewer) threads only autoresearch-run to the reviewer — NOT run-loop-entity-id or the command/surface/metric_parser lineage keys. So these substitutions resolve EMPTY on the reviewer-spawned resynthesize loop (the accumulator lives on the run entity, never on the reviewer loop — true both before and after Phase 3a). The happy-path mock journey does not exercise this (reviewer approves first pass). Fix when the resynthesize path is next worked: either thread run-loop-entity-id + command/surface/metric_parser through rule 07 → reviewer → here, OR have the resynthesize prompt read accumulator state via read_loop_result(run loop)/graph rather than $entity.triple substitution against the reviewer loop. See [[phase3-rule-firing-entity-blocks-rehome]].
